name: voucher-ticket
title: Voucher Ticket
description: A discount ticket with notched, perforated edges slides in, the headline ("DISKON 20%") lands, and the stub tears off while its code reveals with a short scramble. Horizontal in landscape, stacked in portrait. Headline, code, note and shop are variables.
useWhen: Handing out a discount code or coupon in a promo video.
A small shop's voucher for followers or first-time customers.
avoidWhen: A sale price shown on one product: use price-drop.
A stamp or points card: use loyalty-stamp-card.
A countdown to the end of the offer: use event-countdown-clock.
author: Mosio

source.technique: UI animation and kinetic type: a card tearing apart, a code resolving from scrambled characters

variables.label: Shop name
variables.description: Small line at the top of the ticket.

variables.label: Headline
variables.description: Big offer text, kept on one line.

variables.label: Note
variables.description: Conditions under the headline. Leave empty to hide it.

variables.label: Code label
variables.description: Small label above the code on the stub.

variables.label: Code
variables.description: The code that scrambles into place. Letters and digits, up to 12 characters.

variables.label: Font
variables.description: Font family name. Geist is loaded by default; another family must be loaded by the host.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the block sits over your own scene.
